description: Unofficial Grindr client. Free, libre, privacy-centered and community-driven Open Grind is the cross-platform, free, libre, ad-free, tracker-free, privacy-centered and community-driven unofficial client for Grindr queer social network. • Unlocked grid Unlimited profiles for free, ads removed from grid, all filters unlocked • Location spoofing Native geolocation change with OpenStreetMap and location search built-in • Zero ads No ads, first party, third party or self-promotion, no obstructive pop-ups • Privacy by default No analytics, zero trackers, no data is collected by Open Grind developers • Security as foundation Human code review, audit, supply chain security, end-to-end testing
